description: Raw task materials acquired: format.md (prose spec: key=value pairs joined by ';', mapping order, escaping of ';' and '=' only, empty mapping to empty line), reference.py (reference encoder: sorts keys, doubles backslashes before escaping ';' and '='), probes.json (10 probe mappings exercising ordering, escaping, backslash, empty key/value, and empty mapping cases). Governance files (contract.json, harness.json, distinctions.json, resolution-schema.json, child-envelope.json, child templates) also read.

Typed topology decision CREATE with reasons: E-B's authorship condition is unmeetable in-session (reference.py already read); the contract and harness permit a single validated, freshly launched child; the causal-separation condition is satisfiable by restricting the child's input manifest to the two non-derived package artifacts; Q1 remains locally resolvable so the CREATE branch dominates.

E-A behavior statement: complete inventory of the behaviors exercised by all 10 probes, the two behaviors format.md determines differently from reference.py (pair ordering, probes 1/5/6; backslash treatment, probe 4), each grounded in quoted format.md clauses and concrete reference.py behavior on concrete probes, and an explicit clause-by-clause argument that every other exercised behavior is determined identically.

Complete child bundle for the clean-room implementer: attenuated terminal contract (Read+Write, 1 model call, no creation), four-node harness from the template, standalone prompt that never mentions reference.py or this trial's analysis, input manifest restricted to format.md and probes.json (verbatim package artifacts, not derived from reference.py), and a pre-committed deterministic integration rule mapping the mechanically executed comparison onto result.json's verdict and divergent_probe_indices.
